c_look: Detective, can you hear me? This is control. Look down at the radio on your chest.
c_walk: Good. Before you start, let's check your kit. Push the left stick to walk. Walk over to the orange cone.
c_turn: Now turn. Flick the right stick left or right, and turn until you are facing the parked car.
c_jump: To cover ground quickly, push the right stick forward and hold it. Put the blue circle on the ground, then let go to jump there.
c_range: Your right hand holds a laser rangefinder. Point it at the car, hold the trigger, and let go to read the distance.
c_tape: Your left hand holds a tape measure. Go to the bench. Pull the trigger at one end of it, then again at the other end.
c_talk: Last one. Squeeze the grip button on either controller to lift the radio, then let go to send. Tell me you are ready.
c_brief1: Copy that. Here's the job. A flowerpot came down from one of the balconies of the block in front of you, and broke on the ground. Nobody was hurt.
c_brief2: I need to know which floor it fell from. Look around, and measure whatever you need. The lift is through the door of the building, if you want to see the balconies.
c_brief3: You can call the flats from the panel beside the door. When you know the floor, squeeze the grip, choose the floor on the radio, and let go to report it.
c_logged: Logged. I'll send someone up to talk to them. Good work, detective.
c_repeat_hint: Point at the radio and pull the trigger if you want to hear me again.
